item.title: Wichita State women’s hoops earn road revenge with 63–54 win at East Carolina
item.description: Earlier this month, Wichita State women’s basketball was throttled by East Carolina in Koch Arena. item.title: Paws and… a fire
item.description: Officials evacuated Ablah Library Wednesday morning for a small electrical fire. No injuries were reported. According to Wichita State Strategic Communications, an HVAC motor near the elevator shaft started to burn. Individuals in the library evacuated. The Wichita Fire Department controlled the burn and ventilated the building. Ablah was reopened by 10:45 a.m. The evacuation...
